assertions.title: Change detection is O(dirty_entities) not O(all_entities)
assertions.evidence: collect_changed_entity_ids() in storage.rs (lines 343-353) iterates only dirty entities per type via storage.collect_dirty_entity_ids(). It does NOT call entities_with_components(). The doc comment explicitly states 'O(dirty_entities) instead of O(all_entities * type_ids)'. Both change detection tests pass: test_change_detection_only_dirty_entities and test_change_detection_overhead.

commandsRun.observation: Function exists (line ~365) but is NOT called from collect_changed_entity_ids (lines 343-353). Confirmed by reading the implementation: collect_changed_entity_ids uses storage.collect_dirty_entity_ids() instead.
Implementation confirmed: iterates type_ids, calls storage.collect_dirty_entity_ids(&mut changed) for each — no full entity scan.
